questions.explanation:

Chọn B
$F(x)$ = ∫ ( e x + 2sin x )dx = e x - 2 cos x + C .
F ( 0 ) = 20  1 - 2 + $C=20$  $C=21$ .
Vậy: $F(x)$ = e x - 2 cos x + 21 .
